summary.text: Leonard E. Read, previously of the National Industrial Conference Board and the Los Angeles Chamber of Commerce, founded the Foundation for Economic Education in 1946 and served as its president; his own account says he raised the founding money and set the foundation up at Irvington, New York.

facts.claim: Read founded FEE on March 7, 1946 and, per a founding officer, raised the money and set up the foundation at Irvington, inviting the first trustees and officers.
facts.quote: in 1946 Leonard Read raised the money, set up the Foundation at Irvington

connections.quote: Leonard E. Read founded FEE in 1946
